name: check digit by a non-commutative group operation
mechanism: fold the digits through a fixed non-commutative operation table with a position-dependent permutation, so that the check digit changes under every single-digit error and every adjacent transposition

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Verhoeff algorithm' in section Information theory and signal processing / Coding theory / Error detection and correction:

fails_when: catches only the error classes it was designed for
